newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Russian guards seize opium on Tajik-Afghan border.
newsitem.headline: Russian guards seize opium on Tajik-Afghan border.

text.p: Russian border guards in Tajikistan said on Saturday they had seized two drug couriers trying to smuggle raw opium from Afghanistan.

A spokesman for the guards, who help to patrol the border under an inter-government agreement with Tajikistan, said two people who tried to cross the border late on Friday had been supported by gunfire from the Afghan territory.
He said the attempt to smuggle in over 36 kg (80 lb) of raw opium took place some 130 km (81 miles) south from Dushanbe.
The guards say they have seized over 800 kg (1,800 lbs) of drugs on the border this year.
Tajikistan's secular government and the Afghan-based united Islamic opposition, bitter foes since a civil war in 1992, signed a peace agreement last month.
But the peace deal has failed to end violent incidents involving gangs and drug traders operating out of bases in Afghanistan.
